headline: 绿灯军团双榜领跑，影视市场蓄势待发
headlineEn: Green Lantern Dominates Both Screens as Market Gears Up
summary: 今日零部新片上映，本周四部新片蓄力待发；《绿灯军团》影视双线领跑，《末日地堡》剧集热度持续攀升，备受期待的《最后的日出》也引发关注。
summaryEn: No new movies hit theaters today, with four new releases arriving this week. Green Lantern leads both film and TV charts, while Silo keeps gaining momentum and the upcoming The Last Sunrise draws attention.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共有4部新片陆续登场。
industryHighlights.en: No new films released today; four new titles will open this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》在电影与剧集两大榜单同时登顶，热度惊人。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops both movie and TV charts simultaneously.

industryHighlights.text: 《末日地堡》成为本周剧集黑马，讨论度持续走高。
industryHighlights.en: Silo emerges as this week's TV dark horse with rising buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 备受期待的《最后的日出》定档信息引发影迷热议。
industryHighlights.en: The anticipated The Last Sunrise sparks heated fan discussions.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》强势跻身本周电影热度前列。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day breaks into the top tier of weekly movie buzz.
